meta.prompt: Help me schedule a 30 minute meeting with three colleagues (Priya, Marcus and Elena) next week. Let me pick a day (Mon 16, Tue 17, Wed 18, Thu 19, Fri 20 Nov), then one of that day's time slots: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00 or 15:00, where some are taken: Mon 10:00 and 13:00; Tue 09:00 and 14:00; Wed 11:00 and 15:00; Thu 09:00, 10:00 and 13:00; Fri 11:00 and 14:00. Show who is attending and a confirm button. After confirming the card says the meeting is booked, with the day and the time it runs from and to (for example Wed 18 Nov, 14:00 to 14:30).
meta.text:
state day=""
state time=""
state booked=false
let endTime = time=="09:00" ? "09:30" : time=="10:00" ? "10:30" : time=="11:00" ? "11:30" : time=="13:00" ? "13:30" : time=="14:00" ? "14:30" : time=="15:00" ? "15:30" : ""
ChatCard "Schedule a meeting" "30 minutes with Priya, Marcus and Elena" icon:"event" status:"Next week" tone:"accent"
  if booked==false
    SectionLabel "Day" "Next week"
    SegmentedButton =day items:["Mon 16","Tue 17","Wed 18","Thu 19","Fri 20"] -> time=""
    if day!=""
      SectionLabel "Time" "Pick a free slot"
      ChoiceChips =time options:["09:00","10:00","11:00","13:00","14:00","15:00"] disabled:["10:00","13:00"] columns:3
    SectionLabel "Attendees" "3 people"
    Details rows:[["Priya","Invited"],["Marcus","Invited"],["Elena","Invited"]]
    ActionButton "Confirm" tone:"primary" icon:"check" enabled:{day!="" and time!=""} -> booked=true
  if booked
    Receipt "Meeting booked" "{day} Nov, {time} to {endTime}, with Priya, Marcus and Elena." code:"30 min" tone:"good" icon:"check"
